common:generalComment.#text: Calcium hydroxide, also called slaked lime or hydrated lime, is a soft white powder widely used as a raw material in the chemical industry. It forms when calcium oxide is mixed with water. The compound has two hydroxide ions for each ion of calcium. The chemical is ionic, with aqueous and electrolytic dissociations both producing calcium ions and hydroxide ions. It is an inorganic compound which has a white, powdery appearance in its solid-state. However, in its crystalline form, it has a colorless appearance.
氢氧化钙，又称消石灰或熟石灰，是一种白色软粉末，广泛用作化学工业的原料。它由氧化钙与水混合而成。每一个钙离子中含有两个氢氧根离子。这种化学物质是离子性的，在水溶液和电解溶液中都会产生钙离子和氢氧根离子。它是一种无机化合物，固态时呈白色粉末状。不过，在结晶状态下，它的外观是无色的。

common:generalComment.#text: Pumps are mechanical devices that use energy to move fluids from one point to another. They are primarily used to transport various types of fluids including gases, oils, and water. Pumps can be equipped with an impeller or propeller to facilitate this process. There are different types of pumps, such as centrifugal pumps, which convert mechanical energy into hydraulic energy using centrifugal force.

common:generalComment.#text: Urea (urea), also known as urea, carbamide, chemical formula is CH4N2O or CO(NH2)2, is an organic compound composed of carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, hydrogen, is a white crystal. One of the simplest organic compounds, it is the main nitrogenous end product of protein metabolic breakdown in mammals and certain fish.As a neutral fertilizer, urea is suitable for a variety of soils and plants. It is easy to preserve, easy to use, small damage to the soil, is a large use of a chemical nitrogen fertilizer, but also the highest nitrogen content. In industry, ammonia and carbon dioxide are used to synthesize urea under certain conditions.
尿素（urea）又称尿素、碳酰胺，化学式为 CH4N2O 或 CO(NH2)2，是一种由碳、氮、氧、氢组成的有机化合物，是一种白色晶体。作为一种中性肥料，尿素适用于各种土壤和植物。它易于保存，使用方便，对土壤破坏小，是使用量较大的一种化学氮肥，也是含氮量最高的一种肥料。在工业上，氨和二氧化碳在一定条件下合成尿素。

common:generalComment.#text: A sewn bag is a type of bag that is made by sewing fabric together. It can be made in various styles such as general bags, purses, totes, drawstring, diaper, clutches, coin, and many more. The design can be simple or complex, with features such as boxed corners to increase storage space and allow the bag to stand on its own. The bag can be fully lined and have small handles. The size of the bag can vary, and the fabric needed can range from 2 to 5 fat quarters of quilting cotton, depending on the size.
缝制包是一种通过将布料缝制在一起而制成的包。它的款式多种多样，如普通包、钱包、手提包、抽绳包、尿布包、手拿包、零钱包等等。设计可简单也可复杂，其特点是边角采用方框设计，以增加储物空间，并使袋子能够独立存在。包可以是全衬里的，也可以有小提手。包的大小可以不同，所需的布料也可以从 2 到 5 块棉布不等，具体取决于包的大小。

common:generalComment.#text: Adhesives are substances capable of holding materials together in a functional manner by surface attachment that resists separation. They are often used interchangeably with terms like cement, mucilage, glue, and paste. Adhesives can be used to hold, fasten, or bond two or more materials or objects together. They form a tight and long-lasting bond between heavy materials such as wood, metal, tile, brick, concrete, vinyl, drywall and more. Adhesive bonding solutions can join the internal or external components of a product.
粘合剂是一种能够通过表面附着力将材料以功能性方式固定在一起的物质，这种附着力能够防止材料分离。它们经常与水泥、粘液、胶水和浆糊等术语交替使用。粘合剂可用于将两种或两种以上的材料或物体固定、紧固或粘合在一起。它们能在木材、金属、瓷砖、砖块、混凝土、乙烯基、干墙等重型材料之间形成紧密持久的粘合。粘合剂解决方案可以将产品的内部或外部组件连接在一起。
